text: The moment came quietly. Another woman had been speaking to me at my desk. Gunja waited until she had gone, then came straight to me. Her voice was low, but fierce with hurt. She asked what we had been talking about, and told me never to speak to that woman again. I was frightened, and I said only, 'All right.'

text: Not anger. Hurt. Not possession. A terrified love trying, for one instant, to protect what it could not yet name.
